name: ThinkingIndicator
description: Shows that an AI response is being generated.

when: A model is working on a request
Async AI work that would otherwise look frozen
Multi-stage tasks worth showing stage by stage
whenNot: Form submission (use the Button loading state)
guidelines: active controls whether it shows at all
dots suits chat; spinner suits a discrete action
Turn on showElapsed once waits run past a few seconds
Use steps for tool calls, research, and other staged work
accessibility: Elapsed time uses tabular numbers for stability

examples.name: Dots (Default)
examples.description: Three dots bounce in sequence; the quietest option.

examples.name: Pulse
examples.description: A single ring breathes in place.

examples.name: Spinner
examples.description: A rotating arc, for work with a definite end.

examples.name: With Elapsed Time
examples.description: A live counter reassures the reader during long waits.

examples.name: Multi-Step Progress
examples.description: Finished, running, and queued stages read at a glance.
examples.code:
<ThinkingIndicator
  kind="spinner"
  label="Working..."
  steps={[
    { id: '1', label: 'Analyzing request', status: 'complete' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Searching knowledge base', status: 'pending' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Generating response', status: 'idle' },
  ]}
/>

examples.name: With Error Step
examples.description: A failed stage turns red while the next one retries.
examples.code:
<ThinkingIndicator
  kind="spinner"
  label="Retrying..."
  steps={[
    { id: '1', label: 'Connecting to API', status: 'complete' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Fetching data', status: 'error' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Retrying with fallback', status: 'pending' },
  ]}
/>

examples.name: Custom Label
examples.description: Name the actual task instead of a generic status.

relations.note: Show ThinkingIndicator while waiting for assistant message
Typically placed at bottom of ConversationList

propsSummary: active: boolean - whether indicator is visible (default: true)
